description: DocuWriter is an AI-powered platform for creating and managing complete, structured documentation for entire codebases. Teams can connect repositories and generate documentation covering architecture, modules, services, classes, functions, dependencies, APIs, diagrams, READMEs, and other technical components. It supports both individual repositories and larger multi-repository systems. From ChatGPT, users can work with that centralized documentation through Spaces, semantic search, Autopilot, and repository workflows.

defaultPrompt: Generate technical documentation for the source code I provide.
Generate tests for the source code I provide.
Search my Spaces for authentication and summarize the most relevant documents.
